shifts: base plus eight radial shifts of 50/100m, diagonals normalized; separate erosion/dilation checks
policy: Expanded immutable research snapshot for a separately frozen experiment; not operational forecasts or confirmed field/crop labels.

experiment.task: expected core NDVI/NDMI 7 days after an observation; retrospective proxy for inspection support, NOT disease labels
experiment.daily_selection: maximum clear fraction in fixed core; tie latest acquisition; issue at end of acquisition UTC day
experiment.feature_policy: only current/past clear core indices, observed slopes/lag, day-of-year; optional DSM elevation/slope, no field id or future cloud/acquisition lead features
experiment.spatial_holdout: five southernmost fragment representative-point latitudes, frozen before training; never fit/tune on their labels
experiment.selection: 2024 issue and target before 2024-07-01, remaining supported fragments
experiment.test_not_blind: 2026 index history was already visually/descriptively examined; evaluation is held out from fitting/selection, not an untouched external study
experiment.selection_metric: equal weight of NDVI/NDMI, equal total weight per issue calendar day; tie prefer simpler in listed order
experiment.interval: per-output 90% nominal split bound from maximum absolute error across fit-fragments on each calibration issue day; no local/exchangeability guarantee
experiment.production_policy: research only regardless of holdout result; original weather detector and field store unchanged
experiment.historical_availability: C1 reprocessing availability at original 2023/2024 issue date is not proven; this is an acquisition-date retrospective experiment
